newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds start very slow due to holiday.
newsitem.headline: European feeds start very slow due to holiday.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market started very slow this morning as a large part of Europe was closed for May Day public holiday, market sources said.

"There are only a few dealers around and most sellers did not offer material, partly because they don't know what to make of yesterday's sharply higher Chicago close. And while prices for soymeal should be some $8 or $9 up one could find buying interest at those levels anyway with a strong dollar. Most other products were left unchanged," one dealer said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
